name: Flechette Clip, Fragmentation (Major)
text: When triggered, this enhanced wrist launcher ammunition fires a volley of kinetic flechette rounds in a short line 15 feet long and 5 feet wide or a long line 45 feet long and 5 feet wide. A single flechette clip holds enough ammunition for three attacks in a short line or one attack in a long line. Each creature must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d10 kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one. If you lack proficiency in the wrist launcher, you must roll the damage dice twice and take the lesser total.
